text: Pooling every N=64, e<=0.5 run across data_seeds 0 and 1 and reading formation from the trajectories, is the spread in persistent accel_step formation step between data_seeds larger than the spread between model seeds? With data_seed 1, formation is at steps 80-120 and val_mse_ratio at formation is 1.85-3.14 (2.2-4.2% of the step-0 value).
